direction: Sparse layout: 1–2 big points only, large hero title zone, cover/quote friendly, generous margins.
Balanced layout: 3–4 content points with clear hierarchy, regular knowledge-card density.
Dense layout: 5–8 short points, cheatsheet / knowledge-card packing, still readable hierarchy.
List layout: 4–7 numbered or bulleted items stacked, checklist/ranking friendly.
Comparison layout: two clear sides (before/after or A vs B), split composition.
Flow layout: 3–6 sequential steps with arrows or numbered path, process/tutorial friendly.
